content:
Hi everyone,

As mentioned in the announcement, we will be hosting a meeting on 2026-05-19T17:00:00+02:00 at this zoom link to discuss the Lean Machine Learning project, its roadmap and initial directions, and answer any questions. Please join us there if you're interested in learning more.
The meeting will be recorded.

This channel will become more active after the meeting.

Hey @Rémy Degenne ! This is very cool! While building TorchLean, I focussed on parts of RL and it seems like we have some overlapping RL/theory pieces, especially MDPs, Bellman contraction/fixed-point results, rollout/replay invariants, Gymnasium boundary checks, and Float32 runtime numerics. It would be cool to align the APIs and maybe upstream some of TorchLean’s more theory-facing definitions/proofs into LeanML over time if you are interested, cause I would like to learn more from you on the more mathlib style conventions, which I tried to follow in TorchLean but do admit its not perfect!
Reinforcement learning theory is definitely in scope for the LML library. We will talk more about that scope during the meeting.
